newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 up at fixing led by Komernci, SPT.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 up at fixing led by Komernci, SPT.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index continued to post gains at Wednesday's fixing with SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka again making most of the running.
SPT rose 60 crowns to 4,100 while Komercni was up 53 crowns to 1,840. SPT's surge came after last week's announcement of its 1997 first half results which were well received by analysts and traders.
Gains to Komercni, however, have surprised local dealers as the bank's first half profits were well down on the same period last year.

The only forthcoming explanation was that Komercni's shares had been so heavily marked down in the weeks prior to the results announcement that some investors saw it as a cheap way of getting back into the Czech blue chips.
